newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE President Sheikh Zaid heads to the United States for a medical visit.
- Emirates airlines to increase the number of its weekly flights to Nairobi and Jakarta.
- Businessmen from Dubai and Iran discuss setting up a free zone for carpets.

- UAE's acting oil minister, also OPEC president, holds talks in London with the OPEC secretary ahead of an OPEC committee meeting in Vienna on Wednesday; Their talks include supply and demand for oil.
- Half a million dirhams have poured in from the Indian community as donations for people who are trying to leave the UAE before the visa amnesty expires at the end of the month.
- Men who are caught teasing or harassing women in public places will be subject to legal action including fines, jail and confiscation of their vehicle.
- Air India urged to provide 2,000 more seats for amnesty exodus ahead of end-September deadline; airlines are overwhelmed by the rush.
